primary_topics: Invocation prayer delivered by CJP at the 88th birthday celebration of Senate President Jovito R. Salonga, June 22, 2008 -- bilingual (Filipino opening; English continuation)

Prayers for Salonga: 'a healthy body, a robust mind, a joyful spirit and a dogged endurance to lead our country during these troubled times'; to emulate Jesus -- 'humble, upright, obedient and faithful to Your word and Your will'

The things-money-cannot-buy prayer: thanksgiving for material things (food, clothes, homes, cars, travel); then even greater thanks for the essentials money cannot buy (compelling conscience, love of country, pursuit of excellence, moral courage)
Typhoon Frank and MV Princess of the Stars: prayer for victims of the typhoon and the passengers of the ship that sunk off Romblon the day before (June 21, 2008)
sub_topics: Bilingual opening: 'Manalangin po tayong lahat. O Panginoong makapangyarihan, sinasamba ka namin, pinupugay ka namin, pinasasalamatan ka namin. Alam naming kasama Ka namin ngayon sa tahanang ito, ang tahanang pinagpala Mo at ipinagkaloob sa aming mahal na Pinuno ng Senado Jovito at Ginang Lydia Salonga.'
Scripture: 'Sinabi Mo, O Diyos, na tuwing magtitipon ang dalawa o tatlo sa iyong pangalan, naroroon Ka at nakikiisa sa panalangin at hinaing ng iyong mga alagad.' (Matthew 18:20)

National prayer: 'peace and prosperity in our land, sagacity and integrity for our leaders, dignity and solidarity for our people. We pray for a nation of believers, where the weak shall be strong, and the strong shall be just and the just shall be compassionate.'

Things money can buy (thanksgiving): 'the food we are about to partake, the nice clothes we wear, the beautiful homes we live in, the well-engineered cars we move around with, and the luxury of travel that we sometimes indulge in'

Things money cannot buy (greater thanksgiving): 'a compelling conscience that is sensitive to rectitude and propriety, love of country that transcends kinship and friendship, pursuit of excellence that is relentless and dauntless and moral courage to do what is right, regardless of personal consequences'

Salonga birthday petition: 'bless him O Lord with a healthy body, a robust mind, a joyful spirit and a dogged endurance to lead our country during these troubled times and to point to our confused people the way to truth, justice and peace. Anoint him with Your Spirit that he may continue to emulate Your Son, Jesus Christ, humble, upright, obedient and faithful to Your word and Your will.'

Typhoon Frank and MV Princess of the Stars: 'typhoon Frank that is lashing our country at present, especially the ill-fated passengers of MV Princess of the Stars that sunk off the coast of Romblon yesterday. Give the survivors comfort and healing and grant eternal rest to those who unfortunately passed away.'

one_paragraph_summary: Delivered June 22, 2008 as the invocation at the 88th birthday celebration of Senate President Jovito R. Salonga, this bilingual prayer by CJP opens in Filipino: 'Manalangin po tayong lahat. O Panginoong makapangyarihan, sinasamba ka namin... Alam naming kasama Ka namin ngayon sa tahanang ito, ang tahanang pinagpala Mo at ipinagkaloob sa aming mahal na Pinuno ng Senado Jovito at Ginang Lydia Salonga.' It transitions to English for the national petitions: 'peace and prosperity in our land, sagacity and integrity for our leaders, dignity and solidarity for our people. We pray for a nation of believers, where the weak shall be strong, and the strong shall be just and the just shall be compassionate.' The centerpiece is the things-money-cannot-buy thanksgiving: CJP gives thanks for material blessings (food, clothes, homes, cars, travel) but 'even more for inculcating in us the essentials that money cannot buy like a compelling conscience that is sensitive to rectitude and propriety, love of country that transcends kinship and friendship, pursuit of excellence that is relentless and dauntless and moral courage to do what is right, regardless of personal consequences.' The Salonga birthday petition: 'Bless him O Lord with a healthy body, a robust mind, a joyful spirit and a dogged endurance to lead our country during these troubled times and to point to our confused people the way to truth, justice and peace. Anoint him with Your Spirit that he may continue to emulate Your Son, Jesus Christ, humble, upright, obedient and faithful to Your word and Your will.' The prayer closes with an unscheduled petition for victims of Typhoon Frank, 'especially the ill-fated passengers of MV Princess of the Stars that sunk off the coast of Romblon yesterday' -- the passenger ship disaster of June 21, 2008 that entered the birthday celebration's opening prayer.
